functions.summary_ru: Shared scalar transfer G(x)=contrast*pow(x,gamma)+brightness; direct exponent and branch-specific rounding.
details_ru: Cached gamma101cc084, brightness101cc088, contrast101cc08c. For gamma==1, x87 computes contrast*x+brightness. Otherwise converts input float and gamma float directly to doubles XMM0/XMM1, calls100ff550, multiplies contrast, adds brightness, explicitly rounds to float and returns through x87 ST0.

For ordinary positive inputs: contrast*pow(x,gamma)+brightness. Direct exponent, not reciprocal; no input/output clamp. Fallback1010e84d FYL2X then10122e20 F2XM1/FSCALE proves power. Native CRT special values/error policy and optimized SSE bitwise parity remain separate from the formula.
Defaults gl_gamma=1, gl_contrast=1, gl_brightness=0 proven read bytes; initial cached parameters are zero. Call sites independently apply half, quarter or per-channel ratio scaling.

functions.summary_ru: Scales float RGB by255, peak-normalizes bright colors, clips negatives and truncates to bytes.
details_ru: For finite input: rgb*=255; if maxChannel>255 rgb*=255/maxChannel; then componentwise max(rgb,0); convert toward zero to bytes. Shared peak factor preserves positive ratios, not per-channel saturate.
No alpha/gamma. Negative clamp occurs after peak normalization. Domain/NaN/overflow ABI behavior must not be inferred from finite formula.

functions.summary_ru: Double power implementation consumed by native lighting gamma helper.
details_ru: ABI: XMM0 low double base, XMM1 low double exponent, returns double XMM0. Optimized SSE table path; fallback1010e844 receives two stack doubles and returns x87 ST0 which is copied back to XMM0.
Finite ordinary mathematical operation x^g proven by fallback FYL2X then exp2 helper10122e20. This naming does not claim a particular CRT version or bitwise parity with another libm.

functions.summary_ru: x87 power fallback with exponent/base classification and special cases.
details_ru: Ordinary positive branch continuation1010e84d: argument loads, FYL2X1010e89a computes exponent*log2(base), call10122e20 reconstructs2^t. Accepts two stack doubles, returns ST0; ushort decompiler signature is not the caller ABI.

Handles negative-base integer-exponent classification, zero/NaN/infinity and dispatches CRT policy helpers. Formula proof does not fully specify every exceptional result/errno/control-word side effect.

Helper10122e20: Duplicates input, FRNDINT splits integer n and fraction t-n, F2XM1 plus1 forms2^(t-n), FSCALE multiplies2^n, discards saved integer and returns ST0. Called by power fallback after FYL2X.
